name: Instagram
wait: Check Instagram for export availability; timing and menu names can vary. Download it on this phone from the same page.
steps: Open Instagram's "Download your information" page (button below) and sign in if it asks.
Choose "Download or transfer information", then your Instagram account.
Choose "Some of your information" and tick only "Saved".
Choose "Download to device", date range "All time", format "JSON", then "Create files".
When Instagram's email comes, download the zip on this phone.
Come back here and choose the file: the zip, or saved_posts.json from inside it.
